changelog: Settings rows are swapped for the new app: the CS3 Manager entry now sits in the Compose settings list of CloudStream 4.8.0+, and the legacy injected row is only used where it still exists.
Settings section hiding now reports the truth: on the Compose settings host the host owns its row list, so the option is marked as managed instead of silently doing nothing.
Host settings detection accepts both UI generations (SettingsFragment and SettingsFragment2) instead of only the old class name.
New CloudStream home row supported: the host clock row can be hidden and picked in the Live Home editor.
